Calder & Vane Instrument Movers

Do your instruments need to be transported to a new location? Calder & Vane Instrument Movers offers comprehensive services in four separate packages:

  • Standard: You pack up your instruments using your own packing supplies; we simply lift the items onto our van, carry them, and set them down at the destination.
  • Extra: Same as the Standard package, except we will supply the packing materials. These will be sent to your location four days before the scheduled moving date.
  • Superior: This full-service package is designed to save you time and effort. Our crew will carefully pack your instruments and then unpack them after transport.
  • Elite: Includes every benefit of the Superior package. In addition, you may use our climate-controlled storeroom for up to three weeks if needed, and we will position your instruments in the new space.

Special Tenth-Year Anniversary Offer: Recommend a new customer, and receive a $75 store credit valid for any package.

Call us at 555-2094 for a free estimate today.

http://www.regionbizreviews.com/calder-and-vane

Review of Calder & Vane Instrument Movers

By Odette Lambrecht
Rating: ★★★★☆

When I decided to move my music school, I engaged Calder & Vane Instrument Movers to carry my pianos. Because the flooring work at the new hall ran longer than planned, I was thankful that Calder & Vane offered a package with a short-term storage choice. I was also glad of the crew’s assistance with setting the pianos in place at the new hall. But what impressed me most was how fast the team worked. Loading everything onto the van took under half a day, and the unloading went faster still.

Ellsworth Trade Association Recognizes Local Firm

Ellsworth (June 14)—Local business Calder & Vane Instrument Movers has been named the winner of the Community Partner Award by the Ellsworth Trade Association. This is the second time the firm has earned this honor; it was also recognized during its opening year of business.

Established by Rosalind Vane, Calder & Vane Instrument Movers was selected for the award because of its Music for All program, under which the company transports items for nonprofit music schools at no charge. “We believe in returning something to the community that has supported us,” said Ms. Vane at the ceremony.
